groundCutout.basis: Inside the joined footprints the ancient masonry and narrow excavated gap supply the visible surface, preserving the original terrain outside.

buildingCutout.basis: The main pyramid follows the named and independently measured rectangular footprint.

names: Temple of the Feathered Serpent, Teotihuacan
mapIdentity.scope: The individually named footprints establish the temple and adjoining platform widths, relative location, orientation and public stair approach.

note: Contemporary excavator measurements fix the main square base and surviving rubble height. The archival west elevation shows the three well-preserved carved courses and the stair. INAH documents four plain levels on the adjoining western platform.
